title: Harvest Basket ABC
hook: Harvest day grows full by Z!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: colorful 3D harvest storybook, orchard orange and leaf green, baskets and crops, clear centered subjects for segmentation

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child helping with a safe harvest day and noticing what gets picked, carried, stored or simply observed
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: measure how the day is filling rather than claiming every mapped item literally goes in the basket
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: clap-friendly 4/4 harvest walk with lift-and-place accents
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written cumulative harvest scene; use pick, lift, carry, stack, pour and gather vocabulary selectively while clearly separating animals/tools from actual basket contents
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: gather cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe pick/carry/shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. fiddle or woodblock answers after the target, with a warm porch pulse
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: fiddle or woodblock answers after the target, with a warm porch pulse
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Use harvest as a cumulative act of gathering: the day begins with an empty basket, crosses orchard, yard and field work, and ends with a full sense of what the farm produced and used.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child joins harvest day with hands, baskets, rows and carrying motions; the lyric distinguishes what is actually gathered from tools, animals and helpers that make gathering possible.
semanticArc: farm helpers and field work support the harvest
forbiddenGenericLanguage: harvest words are fun to see
fill the basket with every object
